questions.prompt: Which planet is closest to the Sun?

options.text: Venus orbits nearer than the others
Mercury sits in the innermost orbit

questions.explanation: Mercury is the innermost planet. Venus is second, Earth third, and Mars is outside Earth's orbit.

questions.prompt: Which of these are noble gases?
questions.explanation: Helium and neon are noble gases (group 18). Oxygen and nitrogen are diatomic non-metals, not noble gases.

questions.prompt: Water boils at 100°C at standard atmospheric pressure.
questions.explanation: At 1 atm, water's boiling point is 100°C by definition of the Celsius scale.
